keeper_rules.pool_1_2: Each keeper from rounds 1-2 consumes a random available pick from rounds 1-2; two such keepers consume both.
keeper_rules.pool_3_5: Each keeper from rounds 3-5 consumes a random available pick from rounds 3-5.
keeper_rules.pool_6_plus: First 6+ keeper costs round 6, second costs round 7, third costs round 8.
keeper_rules.trade_clock_reset: Trade resets keeper clock for receiving manager.
keeper_rules.waiver_drafted_player_cost: Waiver pickup retains original draft cost if originally drafted.
keeper_rules.undrafted_player_cost: Undrafted then added is treated as 6+.
keeper_rules.keeper_limit_per_manager: A manager may keep a player once; after that must trade/drop/return to draft.
keeper_rules.redraft_reset: Returning to draft resets keeper clock and establishes new cost from new draft position.
